about_the_game:
WeatherPane

WeatherPane is a cozy and lightweight weather simulator that overlays your desktop. Enjoy beautiful weather patterns and ambient weather sounds on your computer, with options to keep cozy weather visuals behind your programs or overlayed on top of them, even adding weather to your games to change the ambience! Easily customize your WeatherPane using a sleek control panel to toggle desired conditions, adjust intensities, change weather volume, and more. Alternatively, allow your WeatherPane to mirror real world weather by simply typing in a location.

Features

  • Mirror weather in real-world locations

  • Manually customize weather conditions and relative intensities

  • Ambient sound with volume control

  • Toggle visuals to overlay desktop only or all applications

  • Weather event presets

  • Offline compatibility (fully functional besides real-world weather feature)

  • Moveable UI panel with dark/light-mode, tooltips, and error notifications.

  • Moveable sun and moon

  • Interacting weather systems (i.e. wind intensity affects precipitation)

  • Hidden features (i.e. rainbow)

  • Optimized code for low resource usage

  • Compatible with video backgrounds and other desktop games

  • Add weather to games with overlay feature (recommend to cap game's FPS and use windowed mode in this case)

Contact

Reach out if there are questions, concerns, or issues.

Email: madsciencegames@yahoo.com
